Subliminal Backrooms Horror

Oct 24, 2026
Your darkest memories are waiting to be uncovered. Step into the subconscious of a troubled man undergoing an experimental therapy through controlled lucid dreams. Explore distorted memories from different stages of his life, where familiar places become unsettling nightmares shaped by loneliness, rejection, fear, and trauma. Search for forgotten locations, discover meaningful objects, solve mysterious puzzles, and uncover fragments of a past that has been buried deep within his mind.Each level represents a different chapter of his life, taking you from childhood to adolescence as reality slowly gives way to disturbing visions and psychological horrors. Explore interconnected areas, unlock new paths, restore your spiritual strength, and prepare for terrifying encounters with the manifestations of his deepest fears. Every memory reveals another piece of his story, while every confrontation brings him closer to overcoming the trauma that has haunted him. Key Features: • Explore Distorted Memories: Discover unsettling locations from the protagonist’s past. • Solve Mysterious Puzzles: Crack codes, manipulate mechanisms, and uncover hidden paths. • Experience Psychological Horror: Face disturbing events, visual distortions, and manifestations of fear. • Confront Your Trauma: Restore your spiritual strength and battle terrifying bosses representing the protagonist’s deepest fears.
